description_en: Retrieves the package URL for audio files of a sound code label batch
description_zh: 调用该接口获取声码标签批次音频打包地址
name: PackageSoundCodeLabelBatchAudio

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the batch
parameters.name: batch_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
